sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved road boundaries. Elevation follows the approximately 28 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source is an open route or branch network, without one validated closed driving order. Choose an embedded component route for playback and recording; this network does not represent a single lap. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.

notes: The operator Full Circuit diagram identifies the full outer Conrod and Coward's Summit, western Lunar Bend, Rogerson's Straight and Lucy's Valley loop, with the smooth Esses crossover. The inner Penrith climb, Joey Dunlop return and angular pit detour are excluded. Independent mapped distance is 1450.5 m; the operator states 1473 m. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 28 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

notes: The operator Perimeter Circuit diagram identifies full outer Conrod and Coward's Summit, western Lunar Bend and the Rogerson's Straight return, bypassing Lucy's Valley and the Joey Dunlop hairpin.
